text: Find the area of the shaded region.
figure: A rectangle drawn wider than tall. A point on the top side splits it into lengths 1 (left part) and 7 (right part); a point on the bottom side splits it into 7 (left part) and 1 (right part). A point on the left side splits it into 1 (upper part) and 4 (lower part); a point on the right side splits it into 4 (upper part) and 1 (lower part). So the rectangle is 8 wide and 5 tall. One segment joins the top-side point (1 from the top-left corner) to the bottom-side point (1 from the bottom-right corner). A second segment joins the left-side point (1 below the top-left corner) to the right-side point (1 above the bottom-right corner). The two segments cross inside the rectangle. Two regions are shaded gray: the four-sided region at the top-left corner bounded by the corner, the two nearby points and the crossing point, and the matching four-sided region at the bottom-right corner bounded by that corner, its two nearby points and the crossing point.
